Answer: B
Reason: The pre-operative image (Figure 1a) shows a massive right-sided opacity causing significant leftward shift of the mediastinum and trachea. The post-operative image (Figure 1c) demonstrates resolution of the mass with surgical clips, return of the heart and trachea toward the midline (relative to the pre-op state, though some residual asymmetry or shift may persist), and partial re-expansion of the right lung which still shows some opacities/atelectasis compared to the clear left lung.
